title: Ethena / USDe - the synthetic 'delta-neutral' dollar and the stablecoin risk taxonomy
source: Public record: Ethena docs + transparency dashboard; Coin Metrics; Forbes; DeFiLlama. Completes the stablecoin taxonomy (fiat-backed vs synthetic vs algorithmic). HONESTY: the delta-neutral mechanism, CEX-hedge dependence, and regulatory-gap are documented fact; supply/APY figures CONFLICT across dates (~$4.4B vs ~$5.5-6B) - reported/varies; 'how long it survives sustained negative funding is unknown' is stated by Ethena itself; contagion severity = interpretation. USDe is NOT positioned as safe OR as a Terra-clone - it is a distinct risk profile.

edges.notes: Guy Young founded Ethena Labs, issuer of USDe - the largest synthetic (crypto-collateralized) dollar after Sky's USDS (fact).

USDe is a SYNTHETIC dollar held to peg by a DELTA-NEUTRAL basis trade: long staked-ETH/LSTs + spot BTC, short an equal notional of ETH/BTC perpetual futures. It is NOT fiat-backed (no T-bill float like USDC) and NOT an over-collateralized CDP (like DAI/USDS); the peg comes from the hedge + arbitrage (fact of mechanism).

Staking USDe -> sUSDe, which accrues the yield (perp funding + staking); sUSDe 7-day APY ~7.1% (Jun 2026, down from ~9.4% in Apr as funding compressed); 7-day unstake cooldown so Ethena can unwind hedges without forced selling (fact; APY reported/varies).

USDe is the flagship of the SYNTHETIC stablecoin category - a third mechanism class alongside fiat-backed (USDC/USDT/USD1) and algorithmic (Terra/UST). Supply figures conflict (~$4.4B Aug-2026 dashboard vs ~$5.5-6B Q2 DeFiLlama) - treat as a snapshot (fact of category; supply reported/varies).
The long leg is mostly staked ETH / LSTs (e.g. Lido stETH) earning ~3% staking yield, plus spot BTC (which earns nothing on its own) - so USDe's collateral is crypto, not cash (fact).

The short-perp hedges sit on CENTRALIZED exchanges (Binance/Bybit/OKX/Deribit) - so exchange failure/insolvency is a live risk that could prevent closing a short; the Bybit hack + Oct flash crash stress-tested the design (fact of dependence; severity interpretation).
Bybit is among Ethena's perp-hedge venues; the 2025 Bybit hack was one of the market-stress events that tested Ethena's off-exchange-settlement + risk management (fact).

USDtb is Ethena's tokenized-Treasuries product; a portion of reserves now sits in USDtb as a dollar-stable buffer OUTSIDE the delta-neutral structure, plus a Reserve Fund (~$73M, ~1.7% of supply) to absorb hedge-failure losses (fact; figures reported/varies).
USDtb holds tokenized US Treasuries - so even the synthetic-dollar issuer partly plugs into the stablecoin-Treasury rail for its stable buffer (fact).

USDe/sUSDe are integrated as collateral across DeFi (Aave, Pendle) and are a significant share of DeFi TVL - boosting capital efficiency but creating CONTAGION/composability risk: a major USDe depeg could cascade through every protocol that accepts it (fact of integration; contagion severity interpretation).

Because USDe is backed by a hedged derivatives trade (not fiat reserves), it does NOT meet the statutory definition of a 'payment stablecoin' - so the GENIUS yield prohibition that constrains USDC does not touch it; USDe pays yield legally, sitting in a regulatory gap (classification as security/commodity/new-class is unsettled) (fact of the gap; classification outcome uncertain).

CONTRAST: USDe is often mis-compared to Terra/UST (Do Kwon's algorithmic dollar that collapsed 2022 via a reflexive mint/burn loop). USDe is mechanically different - a delta-neutral HEDGE, not a reflexive seigniorage token - so it avoids UST's specific failure mode; but it carries its OWN distinct risks (negative funding, CEX counterparty, depeg-contagion). Not a Terra-clone, and not risk-free (interpretation, clearly labeled).
USDe was among the DeFi assets integrated on Plasma at launch - synthetic-dollar liquidity layered onto a stablecoin L1, compounding both chains' risk surfaces (fact of integration).
